items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: I'm sure I didn't think I was, you know, why nobody said he played around here?

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. One fellow I wanna ask you, maybe you don't know, but the seems that I never asked him, it seems like he's from here, but I hear a lot of people talking about him, but Al Wynn, is he from New Orleans? Yeah?

Yeah, but I don't think he played down here. We were talking about that, Willie Humphrey was saying how many guys were from here like Simeon and Al Wynn and they didn't play anything down here. Uh-huh. Preston Jackson, you know.
I'm sure I didn't think I was, you know, why nobody said he played around here?
